title: Finite dualizing scalar comparisons respect every target transition
statement: Fix D,l,E⊂L,X as in [lem-coef-integral-finite-extension], and coherent integral dualizing data w_E,w_L [def-sf-coherent-integral-dualizing-datum]. Let T be the strict completed scalar extension [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension]. For n≥0 form f_n:r_n(T omega_E)→r_n omega_L as the normalized tensor quotient comparison, scalar extension of w_E.reduction_n, the counit-defined finite dualizing coefficient map finiteU, and the inverse of w_L.reduction_n, in that order [def-sf-integral-finite-extension-models]. Then for every n≤m, f_m followed by the target normalized DVR transition equals the source normalized transition followed by restriction of f_n. This assertion includes every target exponent, not only ramification multiples.

proof.text: Postcompose the required equality with restriction of the target reduction isomorphism. Target coherence cancels the inverse target reduction and gives the target finite exceptional transition.

Use the finite mixed quotient square to replace finiteU_m followed by the target exceptional transition. Source coherence replaces the scalar extension of its reduction followed by the exceptional transition by scalar extension of the integral reduction transition followed by restriction of the lower reduction. Naturality of scalarReductionExchange moves that reduction map across the mixed map.

Apply the scalar quotient transition square to K=omega_E and its completeness proof. Functoriality and associativity identify the remaining composite with restriction of the lower finite map. Cancel the target reduction isomorphism.
